dedupe_keys.name: bahrain bourse trading reports and monthly quarterly and annual bulletins

description: Bahrain Bourse, the kingdom's licensed securities exchange and, through Bahrain Clear, its central depository, publishes market statistics on its website. The homepage and bulletin pages read on 2026-09-29 link daily and weekly trading reports, an investors trading report, monthly, quarterly and annual bulletins, annual reports, research reports and sustainability reports; the monthly bulletin archive offers years 2003 to 2021. Coverage: national, Bahrain, listed securities including shares, bonds and sukuk, mutual funds, REITs and treasury bills. Format and access: free PDF reports and web pages; market data on the site are delayed by 15 minutes. Licence: not stated. Caveats: the monthly bulletin archive shown stops at 2021, so newer series may sit only in the daily, weekly and annual reports; this is financial market data, relevant to infrastructure only as the operating statistics of a financial market utility; the old address bahrainbourse.com.bh no longer answers. Simulation uses: operating baselines of a financial market infrastructure for studies of cascading effects of power or telecom outages on trading. Related records: compare with Bahrain's oil and gas open data (data-bahrain-moo-oil-gas-open-data) and Oman's telecom open data (data-tra-oman-telecom-open-data).
